players.product: Advantage2 annealing quantum computers and dual-rail superconducting gate-model systems (Quantum Circuits)

quarterly_data.signal: D-Wave 8-K: on October 1, 2026 D-Wave launched a beta program for its gate-model quantum computing simulator, built around its dual-rail superconducting gate-model technology and accessed through the Leap cloud service and Ocean SDK, giving select customers early access before general availability; participants include BBVA, FirstQFM, Florida Atlantic University and the Julich Supercomputing Centre. D-Wave plans development bundles combining access to the simulator and future gate-model systems.
